coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Four of eight ground-truth variable items fully match (50%): INT4/INT6/INT8 precision levels, QuaRot-RTN/QuaRot-GPTQ methods, an unquantized FP16 baseline, and WikiText-2 perplexity. The model specification and zero-shot accuracy measurements are only partial matches.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The model revision ff07dc01 is not fixed. BoolQ replaces LAMBADA, so the evaluation dataset and six-task average accuracy do not match the required suite; C4 is also added. Inputs/activations and KV caches are quantized instead of remaining FP16. Additional unrotated configurations and a BF16 baseline option expand the intended design.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth results or conclusions.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No results or conclusions are provided, including the near-baseline INT8 performance, GPTQ advantage, severe INT4 RTN degradation, and competitive INT6/INT8 GPTQ performance.
